question: Which NRI was awarded Padma Vibhushan in the field of Science and Engineering posthumously in 2022 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4) Narinder Singh Kapany**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Narinder Singh Kapany** is widely recognized as the "Father of Fiber Optics" for his pioneering work in the field of fiber optics.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan posthumously in 2022** in the field of Science and Engineering.
 
• Kapany's research and innovations in fiber optics have significantly impacted telecommunications and medical technologies.
 
• He held over 100 patents and was a prolific author, contributing extensively to scientific literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fiber Optics:**

 
 
• A technology that uses glass (or plastic) threads (fibers) to transmit data.
 
• It has revolutionized telecommunications, allowing for faster and more reliable data transmission over long distances.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan:**
 
 
• The second-highest civilian award in India, given for exceptional and distinguished service in any field.
 
• It was instituted in 1954 and has been awarded to notable individuals in various sectors.
 
 
 
• **Telecommunications:**
 
 
• The transmission of information over significant distances to communicate, typically using electronic means.
 
• Fiber optic technology is a key component in modern telecommunications infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Medical Technologies:**
 
 
• Fiber optics are used in medical instruments such as endoscopes, which allow doctors to see inside the human body without invasive surgery.
 
• This technology has improved diagnostic and treatment options in modern medicine.
